name: agentic-self-hosting
goal: Harness hosts itself: component contracts, dual-graph impact, scenario evidence, frozen budgets, Git-native notes and evidence history, and a protected prebuilt /harness console are proven by failing-then-passing acceptance tests

title: Stage A - contracts, registry, unit scaffold and source graph: acceptance tests fail on unchanged behavior, then pass unchanged.
Stage B - module, Wasm, native-process and HTTP runtimes with Rust kernel parity and measured default: red then green.
Stage C - scenario contracts, verification, budgets and reasons: red then green.
Stage D - Git notes, LFS evidence branch, sync, hooks and CI: red then green.
Stage E - reused /harness console, protected endpoints and SvelteKit installer: before screenshots, red, then green screenshots at 1440, 920 and 390.
Stage F - self-host registry, fixtures, migration, packaging, full checks and acceptance.

evidence: Scope, public interfaces and per-stage acceptance gates recorded in specification/features/planned/agentic-self-hosting.md; baseline bun run check passed on untouched 6cf10dd (239 unit, 52 CLI E2E, 1 package, 88 reports tests; log work/logs/00-baseline-check.log).

title: Stage B repairs from independent review: elapsed deadlines, one portable JSON contract, the stated coverage rule and calibration provenance.

evidence: RED work/logs/stage-b2-red.log on the then-current code: 11 tests failed in 6 files and cargo test failed. The synchronous deadline probe returned success after its 5 ms deadline; the reference accepted 1e400, lone surrogates and 65-level nesting; the Rust typed path accepted an out-of-range number in an ignored field; benchmark runs carried no calibration label. GREEN work/logs/stage-b-green.log: 14 Stage B files, 46 tests. The four new test files are unchanged since red; vectors grew 26 to 38 before red and to 39 after, with every earlier vector unchanged (work/logs/stage-b-test-diff.log). Full bun run check EXIT=0 (work/logs/stage-b-check.log): cargo fmt --check, clippy -D warnings, cargo test 2 passed on 39 shared vectors; 304 unit, 73 CLI E2E, 2 package, 88 reports tests; both audits; units check 368 units, 6 uncertain. harness kernel parity 150 cases including 19 raw edge texts, 0 mismatches for wasm and process (work/logs/stage-b-parity.json). The stronger parity command found that the persistent native process did not answer a blank line; fixed and pinned by a vector. The first portability check cost 2.84 ms per pass at 10k nodes and doubled module latency; rewritten to 0.285 ms and run once on the module path. Recorded benchmark is calibration from an uncommitted tree: verified false, no tested revision, artifact and source hashes kept. In-process deadlines reject late results but cannot interrupt work; hard limits need process isolation in the Stage C verifier.
